paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.50% on average, with S&P 500 strongest (+1.15%) and Euro Stoxx 50 weakest (-1.04%). Brent crude changed +2.42% to 104.72. Gold changed +1.30% to 4,216.2998. Bitcoin changed -3.34% to 82,917.6016. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.244%, a relative move of -0.63%. Among the firms tracked, 3i Group (-5.99%) and ConocoPhillips (+5.80%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Germany blocks Chinese acquisition in its largest seaport (FT World). Berlin rejects state-owned Cosco’s takeover of a Hamburg port logistics group ‘on security concerns’ Deals and capital markets: Starbucks has explored takeover of Chipotle in restaurant megadeal (FT World). Purchase of $41bn market-value burrito chain would rank as largest restaurant acquisition of all time Central banks and macro: India’s interest rate rise tests an economy of two speeds (FT World). Plus, meet the Tata kingmaker Central banks and macro: India’s central bank tries to shore up rupee as it nears record lows (FT World).
